newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Thursday that one lot of 300-lb steers was exported Wednesday through Nogales, Arizona, from Mexico at 63 cents/lb.
USDA added that not enough head went through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, for indicative market prices.
Around 1,000 head were imported through Nogales with the bulk of supply consisting of steers weighing between 300-500 lb, USDA said.
Through Santa Teresa around 500 head were imported, including one lot of previously contracted steers weighing 400-600 lb and 300 head of "corriente" steers weighing 300-500 lb, it added.
